senses.gloss:
पैतामह a. (ही f.) [पितामह-अण्]
1
Relating to a paternal grandfather.
--2 Inherited or derived from a
paternal grandfather
--3 Derived from,
presided over by, or relating to,
Brahmā; R. 15. 60.
--हाः (pl.)
Ancestors, forefathers.

पैतामहिक a. (की f.) Relating to
a paternal grandfather.

पैतृक a. (की f.) [पितृत आगतं
पितृरिदं वा ठञ्]
1 Relating to a father.
--2 Coming or derived from a father,
ancestral, paternal; पदमृद्धमजंन पैतृकं
विनयेनास्य नवं च यौवनं R. 8. 6;
18. 40; Ms. 9. 104; Y. 2. 47.
--3
Sacred to the Manes.
--कं A Śrāddha
performed in honour of the Manes
or deceased ancestors.

1 The son of an
unmarried woman (पितृप्तत्याः पुत्रः).
--2
The son of an illustrious person
(पितृमतः पुत्रः).

पैतृष्वसेयः, पैतृष्वस्रीयः The son
of a paternal aunt.

पैतृष्वसेयः, पैतृष्वस्रीयः The son
of a paternal aunt.

पैत्त (त्ती f.), पैत्तिक a. (की f.)
Bilious.

पैत्तल a. (ली f.) Made of brass,
brazen.

पैत्र a. (त्री f.) [पितुरिदं अण्]
1
Relating to a father or ancestors
[]
generally, paternal, ancestral.
--2
Sacred to the Manes.
--त्रं
1 The part
of the hand between the forefinger
and the thumb. (Also पैत्र्प in this
sense).
--2 A year, month, or day
sacred to the Pitṛs.
